snippet: The Agent Client Protocol (ACP) is an open JSON-RPC standard for connecting code editors to AI coding agents. More specifically, the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) standardizes communication between code editors/IDEs and coding agents and is suitable for both local and remote scenarios.

title: Agent Client Protocol (ACP): AI Agents in JetBrains & Zed (2026) | danilchenko.dev
snippet: The Agent Client Protocol (ACP) is frequently compared to the Language Server Protocol (LSP). The closest analogy is the Language Server Protocol. After LSP, one language server worked everywhere. ACP does the same for AI agents. LSP standardizes language features (autocomplete, go-to-definition) between editors and language servers. ACP standardizes AI agent interaction (prompts, sessions, file permissions, streaming) between editors and coding agents.
claim: ACP is the LSP equivalent for AI agents, standardizing agent interaction across editors while LSP standardized language features.
